blocks.text: Unilab, Inc. (Unilab), the leading and most-trusted pharmaceutical brand in the Philippines, has emerged as the highest-ranked company of ASEAN origin in TIME magazine and Statista’s Asia-Pacific’s Best Employers of 2027, placing 24th among 500 companies across the region. The Campos-Hess-led Filipino pharmaceutical company scored 89.15 out of 100, outperforming other companies founded and headquartered in the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN), including some of Southeast Asia’s largest conglomerates.
